ideas.pitch: An AI-powered industrial compliance and land monitoring platform tailored for Indian state industrial development corporations, using satellite imagery and multi-agent graph intelligence to flag environmental violations.
ideas.title: EcoGraph India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact technical complexity and regional governance problem that won the Xcelerate Hackathon, directly targeting judges looking for tangible public-sector impact.

ideas.pitch: A localized nutritional wellness platform combining regional Indian dietary databases with multi-agent RAG to deliver personalized meal plans and micro-nutrient tracking for clinical and daily use.
ideas.title: AyurNutri AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the winning formula of the Mealzy 24-Hour Hackathon by pairing consumer health utility with a polished, domain-specific RAG interface.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace for agricultural supply chain contracts featuring automated milestone tracking and secure escrow payments.
ideas.title: AgriChain Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven architecture of the Synthesis Hackathon winner by integrating autonomous agent workflows with verifiable financial transactions.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered anti-money laundering risk detection and investigation platform tailored for Indian fintech regulations, using Focal LightGBM and graph intelligence to uncover transaction rings.
ideas.title: FinGuard AML India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the blueprint of the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon winner by delivering heavy enterprise-grade risk analysis with explainable outputs for judges.

ideas.pitch: A Poisson regression and GAM-based incident forecasting dashboard designed for Indian power grid infrastructure to predict equipment failures and load anomalies with calibrated confidence intervals.
ideas.title: GridCast AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the rigorous statistical modeling that secured 1st place at the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon, standing out among basic UI-wrapper projects.
